observations.body: The passage gives very little explanation. Yahweh meets “him” and seeks to kill him; Zipporah circumcises her son, touches the foreskin to “his feet,” speaks of a bridegroom of blood, and the threat ceases.
observations.label: Bridegroom of blood

observations.body: The passage presents Circumcision as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Circumcision

observations.body: The passage places Yahweh meets and releases beside Circumcision.
observations.label: Yahweh meets and releases

payload.posture: Read Exodus 4:24–26 as one movement in Moses's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.title: Bridegroom of blood
